name: NAN (Noise-Aware NeRFs)
definition: A burst-denoising method that extends IBRNet to handle degraded noisy images (e.g., low-light) by modifying feature extraction, feature aggregation, and color blending to be noise-aware, rather than generating novel views.
summary: NAN is a burst-denoising method that extends IBRNet to fix noisy images by explicitly modeling spatial noise statistics through 3D blending kernels and cross-view variance features.
